Shenzhen Odile Technology Ltd Focus on LED industrial lighting product development, production and sales. At the beginning of the establishment of the company, with LED industrial lighting radiator, (including: LED high bay profiles and phase change radiator, LED floodlight die-casting kit, LED tunnel light profiles and die-casting kits and other radiators and related kits) Production and sales direction. In the radiator, the kit has accumulated valuable experience and advanced production technology. From the beginning of 2008, on the basis of radiator and shell kit, the company expanded the production line, increased the LED industrial lighting finished product development, production and sales business, and further improve the company's products. The company's production plant expanded to 4000 square meters, equipped with advanced optical laboratory (IES test report), light color test, waterproof test, high pressure test a large number of advanced equipment testing equipment, to ensure product quality to provide a strong technical support The The company passed the ISO9001: 2008 quality management system certification, the product through the ETL, DLC, SAA, TUV, CB certification, the products sell well in more than 100 countries and regions! At present, the company unswervingly follow the road of independent research and development to better products and more cost-effective product feedback to our customers support! At the same time, we also look forward to working with more new customers to establish mutually beneficial win-win cooperation!



　    

  The company was established in 2008, the beginning of the establishment of the radiator, shell suite of R & D, production and sales as the main core business. After years of development and accumulation, now has its own spraying workshop, die-casting workshop, oxidation workshop, machining workshop With the industry competitive advantage of the processing sector and a variety of advanced production equipment, LED lighting industry in Shenzhen has a good reputation and a large number of customer groups. The company from the original LED floodlight shell production and sales, to LED solar street light and solar garden light  shell and finished the success of the product, Shenzhen LED lighting industry witnessed the company's transformation.


　    The company has an independent design research and development departments, experienced LED lighting thermal structural engineers and mold design engineers more than. At the same time, with the advantages of manufacturing management, as well as in the die-casting, plastic, aluminum extrusion, surface treatment and other aspects of mature supply chain resources, for the majority of customer groups to provide fast and efficient cost-effective LED cooling package and LED lighting finished lamps The The company is willing to work with the majority of new and old customers, together to build more brilliant!

    Companies in the "integrity-based, win-win cooperation, beyond the self, continuous innovation," the production concept make persistent efforts to the best quality service, the most reasonable price feedback new and old customers and customers to establish long-term friendly relations of cooperation, mutual benefit , And common development, to join hands in creating a better tomorrow, at the same time invite new and old customers visit Hong Pu Xin guidance and exchanges.
